2026-10-11.details: Beginner judoka up to 16 years · Tournament costs € 8.50 (cash, payable at the weigh-in)

sections.label: About the tournament
lines: Only for beginner judoka who want to gain competition experience (no competition judoka).
Organized by Budoschool Cor Schuurbiers, about once a month.
We always try to make sure everyone judos 4 matches.

sections.label: Weigh-in & match times
lines: Weigh-in 8.15-8.30 (4 up to 16 years)
Be present a quarter before the weigh-in starts
Matches start around 8.30-8.45

sections.label: Points & rewards
lines: Loss 2 · draw 3 · designated winner 4 · yuko 5 · wazari 6 · ippon 7
Flags: 40 yellow · 80 orange · 120 green · 160 blue · 200 brown · 240 black
Medals: 300 bronze · 360 silver · 420 gold · 600 points = trophy

sections.label: Costs & registration
lines: € 8.50 per participant, payable in cash at the weigh-in in the hall
Fill in digitally via the registration link (Sign up button)

2026-10-17.details: Recreational tournament for all ages. Sign up by September 30 at the latest.

sections.label: About the tournament
lines: Recreational mass-sport tournament — amateur referees, emphasis on sportsmanship and fun.
Location: Bou-Kooijmanstraat 48, 4698 AM Oud-Vossemeer

sections.label: Costs & payment
lines: € 7.50 per judoka (including 1 drink)
Transfer to: NL81 RBRB 0939 7268 15 in the name of Judovereniging O.V.J.V.
Mention: first & last name judoka + jubileumtoernooi OVJV

sections.label: Attendance
lines: Everyone at 09:00

sections.label: Sign up
lines: By September 30 at the latest
Via the registration form (button on the right)
